HowItWorks.metaTitle: How it works — book a session in three steps
HowItWorks.metaDescription: Browse practitioners, book a time in your timezone, and pay securely online. See how booking a tarot, astrology, reiki, or coaching session works.
HowItWorks.heading: How it works
HowItWorks.subheading: Find clarity in three simple steps.
HowItWorks.step1Body: Browse practitioners by practice (tarot, astrology, reiki, coaching) — or straight by the question on your mind. Each profile shows what they help with, reviews from real clients, and their open times.
HowItWorks.step2Body: Choose a service and a time that suits you. Times are shown in your timezone. Pay securely online — and you're set.
HowItWorks.step3Body: You'll get a confirmation and everything you need for the session. Show up at your time — in person or online — and receive attention focused entirely on you.

BecomePractitioner.metaDescription: List your tarot, astrology, reiki, or coaching practice. Your own profile, a calendar that works for you, and secure bookings and payments — handled for you.
BecomePractitioner.heading: Become a practitioner
BecomePractitioner.subheading: You tend to your gift. We'll handle the rest.
BecomePractitioner.introBody: If you have a gift — to read, to heal, to guide — you probably know the other side of it too: the bookings, the calendar, the payments, keeping an online presence, finding the people who need exactly you. The hours that go to admin instead of to the work itself.
BecomePractitioner.pitchBold: {siteName} takes on the technical and the organizational — so you can focus on what you do best.
BecomePractitioner.benefit1Body: Present your practice your way: your words, your images, your services.
BecomePractitioner.benefit2Title: A calendar that works for you
BecomePractitioner.benefit2Body: You set when you're available; clients only see your open times. No back-and-forth to arrange.
BecomePractitioner.benefit4Body: We connect you with seekers who need your particular practice.
BecomePractitioner.benefit5Body: You decide your services, your prices, your time.
BecomePractitioner.trustNote: Working with people in tender moments takes trust and care. We hold the same — toward you.
BecomePractitioner.closingBody: Ask your cards, your tools, your intuition. If it feels like a "yes" — welcome.

About.metaDescription: {siteName} connects people seeking clarity with verified tarot, astrology, energy, and coaching practitioners across Bulgaria.
About.heading: About {siteName}
About.body1: {siteName} is a meeting place — between people seeking clarity and practitioners who can help them find it.
About.body2: We believe everyone reaches a crossroads sometimes — in love, in work, in themselves — and that what helps most is often a conversation with someone who sees a little further. Tarot, astrology, energy practices, coaching — different paths toward the same thing: understanding yourself, and your moment, a little better.
About.body3: We built {siteName} to make that meeting easy, safe, and full of trust — for seekers and practitioners alike.

FAQ.metaTitle: FAQ — booking, payment, cancellations, and privacy
FAQ.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about booking a session: how payment works, cancellation policy, confidentiality, and how to know a practitioner is trustworthy.
FAQ.heading: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.a1: Browse practitioners, choose a service and an open time, and confirm. You'll get a confirmation email with everything you need for the session.
FAQ.a2: You pay securely online when you book. Nothing is required in person.
FAQ.a3: Yes — you can cancel within the window set by the practitioner and receive a full refund. If the practitioner cancels, you're also fully refunded.
FAQ.a4: Yes. Your conversation with the practitioner is between the two of you. Any review you leave is shown anonymously.
FAQ.q5: What if it's my first time seeking this kind of help?
FAQ.a5: That's completely normal. Many people come for the first time, at a moment of question or doubt. There's no wrong way to start — choose a practitioner who feels trustworthy to you.
FAQ.q6: How do I know the practitioners are trustworthy?
FAQ.a6: Every profile shows ratings and reviews from real clients who actually had a session — so you can see others' experience before you choose.
FAQ.a7: It depends on the practitioner and the service — you'll see it on their profile and when you book.

Moderation.suspended_body: Your account is hidden from search, not accepting new bookings, and you can't publish services right now. Your existing bookings still stand — we'll be in touch about them.
Moderation.payouts_body: Your payouts are temporarily on hold while we look into something. You can still hold sessions and take bookings; your money is safe and will be paid out once this is resolved.

Immediate.heading: Available now
Immediate.keepTabOpen: Keep this tab open — close it and you stop appearing available. Best on desktop; a backgrounded phone tab will drop you offline.
Immediate.explainer: Turn this on to take immediate sessions from clients who are ready now. You'll be alerted when someone requests you and have ~2 minutes to confirm.
Immediate.error_noNotifications: Your browser doesn't support notifications, which this needs.
Immediate.error_permissionRequired: Allow notifications to go available — you can't answer a request you're not alerted to.
Immediate.error_offline: Connection lost — you've been set to offline.
Immediate.waiting: Waiting for the practitioner to confirm… {seconds}s
Immediate.confirmed: Confirmed — the practitioner is ready for your session.
Immediate.notAvailableWithTimes: Not available right now — see their available times below.
Immediate.paymentProcessingBody: Setting up your session — this only takes a moment.
Immediate.bookedBody: Your session is confirmed. You can join now.
Immediate.paymentCancelledBody: The practitioner is free again. You can try again from their profile.
Immediate.immediateUnavailableBody: The session couldn't be completed. If you were charged, it will be refunded.
Immediate.block_no_services: You don't have any active services.
Immediate.block_in_session: You're in a session right now.
Immediate.block_blocked: This period is blocked in your schedule.
Immediate.block_next_too_soon: Your shortest service is {minutes} min, and your next session starts in {startsIn} min.
Immediate.block_next_too_soon_free: You'll be able to go available at {time}.

empty.title: Your stats will appear here
empty.body: Once people start finding you, this shows how many viewed your profile, opened your schedule, booked, and completed a session — and where they drop off. The gap between opening your schedule and booking is the most useful number: lots of people checking availability without booking can point to price, or a schedule that suits no one.
